preamble: The shift from [ə] to [a] lowers the central mid vowel to the open central vowel. It is a regular reflex of Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *ə in several Austronesian languages: in Makassarese, where the following consonant is geminated (*ənəm > annaŋ 'six'), and in Bikol (*ənəm > anóm).

examples.note: The consonant after a former schwa is geminated.
